_description: Symbolic rule base for Level 5. Each rule defines antecedent predicates (binary columns from level5_labeled.csv) and a consequent intent. rule_strength_init is the starting value for the learnable rule_strength parameter (sigmoid-bounded). Rules are compiled into the differentiable rule layer â€” they are structural, not a post-hoc correction.

rules.name: R1_metric_investigate
rules.description: Metric or incident queries with SRE domain context are investigation requests
rules._rationale: is_metric_query -> 55% investigate; is_known_incident -> 50% investigate. OR gives broad coverage.

rules.name: R2_runbook_execution
rules.description: Utterances involving runbook/procedural actions are execution requests
rules._rationale: has_runbook -> 95% execution. AND with is_sre_domain avoids false triggers on out-of-domain action words.

rules.name: R3_incident_summarization
rules.description: Known incident entities in SRE domain lean toward summarization
rules._rationale: is_known_incident -> 39% summarization when no runbook action. NOT has_runbook guards against R2 overlap.

rules.name: R4_unknown_out_of_scope
rules.description: Unknown entity type outside SRE domain implies out_of_scope
rules._rationale: is_unknown + not sre_domain -> cleanest out_of_scope signal. Mirrors Level 4 TYPE_C constraint logic.
